summary: GLOBALFOUNDRIES filed a Form 6-K reporting a new $1.5 billion senior unsecured revolving credit facility replacing an existing $1.02 billion facility. The facility matures August 21, 2031, borrowings bear SOFR/EURIBOR-based rates plus margins, and the company guarantees subsidiary obligations. This is routine financing, not a special situation. No deal terms, no event affecting shareholders.
